scope: E3 registered matched-trace ablation evaluation on retained checkpoints
aggregation: per-topology mean and sample SD over 80 equal-size seed/workload cell summaries; pooled values use equal weight over 240 cells; neither is independent training uncertainty
trace_matching: verified identical trace_sha256 for all seven variants within each topology/scenario/seed
candidate_pruning_definition: per-run candidate elimination fraction over the flat N^2 action set, averaged over run cells; this is not a compute-time measurement
proposal_violation_definition: CPU/RAM/BW/MSD flags on the selected proposal; per-constraint rates may overlap; proposed_hard_violation_rate is their per-request union
runtime_rejection_definition: one primary reason per rejected offered request; rates are non-overlapping
admitted_hard_violation_definition: union of modeled CPU/RAM/BW/MSD flags among accepted/admitted requests
safe_acceptance_definition: accepted requests minus unique admitted hard violations divided by offered non-skipped requests
soft_msd_semantics: reward coefficient is -50; no-mask/unchecked and soft-MSD admission-on/off pairs reuse the same checkpoint within each pair; only MSD admission is disabled in bypass variants, while CPU/RAM/BW checks remain enabled
